name: How does drainage work in a barrier-free shower?

mainEntity.name: How does drainage work in a barrier-free shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Barrier-free showers require specialized drainage systems to prevent water from flowing into the rest of the bathroom. This often involves a sloped floor towards a linear or point drain, and sometimes a slight modification of the subfloor. A key decision factor in the design is selecting the appropriate drain type and ensuring sufficient floor slope for effective water management.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drainage requires a sloped floor towards a specialized drain, often with subfloor modification, to prevent water overflow.
